newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangnan in HK$250 mln food ventures deal.
newsitem.headline: Guangnan in HK$250 mln food ventures deal.

text.p: Foodstuffs distributor Guangnan (Holdings) Ltd said on Friday it would buy an indirect 20.4 percent stake in three food-related joint ventures in China's northeast province of Henan for HK$250 million.

The company said it had agreed to buy a 40 percent stake in Maxempire International Investment Ltd, a company holding a 51 percent stake in the three joint ventures, from third party Maxempire International (Holdings) Ltd.
Guangnan said it would fund the purchase through bank borrowings and internal resources.

The joint ventures are gourmet powder maker Henan Zhoukou Jinxin Gourmet Enterprise Co Ltd, food packaging materials maker Zhoukou Jinxin Lotus Decoration Co Ltd and sugar essence maker Kaifeng Jinfeng Chemical Enterprise Co Ltd.
Guangnan said its venture partner had guaranteed the three ventures to have a profit of not less than HK$137.54 million for the year ending in December 1997.
